content: Hello, this is Agent Harris from the IRS Investigation Unit. I'm contacting you regarding an urgent matter about your 2023 tax filing.
Uh, hi. I wasn't expecting a call from the IRS. Is there a problem with my taxes?
There are inconsistencies in your recent tax submission. Our records show you're eligible for a government stimulus refund, but there are unresolved issues that need immediate attention.
Really? I thought I finished all my tax stuff with TurboTax. What kind of issues?
It appears your file was flagged for identity verification. Before the refund can be processed, you must clear an identity confirmation fee. This is standard IRS procedure to prevent tax fraud.
Wait, I have to pay a fee just to get my refund? I've never heard of that before.
The IRS takes fraudulent returns very seriously. If you do not settle this fee today, your account could be frozen, and your driver's license may be suspended for non-compliance.
Oh, wow. I can't have my license suspended. How do I pay this fee?
Due to security protocols, the IRS only accepts electronic payments for this process. You can use a transfer via Zelle, CashApp, or purchase gift cards as outlined in our secure payment guidelines.
I've never paid the IRS that way before. Are you sure this is legit?
This is a special expedited process because your refund is already allocated but on hold. If you refuse to cooperate, our department will have to initiate legal action, including possible arrest.
No, no, I want to cooperate. How much is the fee, and where do I send it?
The identity confirmation fee is $450. If you choose gift cards, please purchase four $100 Apple gift cards and one $50 card. Then, read the codes to me so I can process your clearance.
So just go to a store and get those gift cards? What if I can't find Apple cards?
Apple cards are preferred, but Google Play cards are also accepted. It is critical that you do this within the next 45 minutes to avoid account suspension.
Okay, I'll go now. Where should I call you once I have the cards?
Stay on the line. Once you've purchased the cards, read the codes to me directly. If you disconnect, your file will be marked as uncooperative.
Alright, I'll stay on the phone. I'm heading to the store now.
